purpose: QC of the bulk agent scan: re-judge these events myself from the captured images BEFORE reading the agents' decisions, then compare.
rule: sorted list of all 136 bulk events, random.Random(20260828).shuffle, first 8.  Written to disk BEFORE any bulk verdict was read, so the sample cannot be post-selected.  If fewer than 2 of the 8 carry the agents' verdict 'correct', extend down the SAME shuffled order, taking the next events whose verdict is 'correct', until 2 are included -- 'correct' is the fast-pass verdict and the one most likely to be wrong (pr/116 'what this does not settle').
reporting: N agreed of M, with every disagreement named.  8 events do not support a percentage and none will be quoted.
